recommendation: Keep the source fix. It narrowly completes the Published DSTU1 mapping request in current build-scoped source without restoring the obsolete Medication.name element or reopening the later Medication.code/name design decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-7805 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the DSTU1 QA process asking to add RXC-2.2 Component Text to the Medication v2 text/name mapping alongside RXO-1.2, RXE-2.2, RXD-2.2, RXG-4.2, and RXA-5.2 text components.
initial_application: Jira comments recorded QA application, and git-svn commit 651364cb09 lists #7805 in a 2015 Medication v2 mapping batch. Inspection showed that hunk added RXC-2.1 Component Code to Medication.code for companion FHIR-7806, while exact source history did not show RXC-2.2 Component Text carried forward.
additional_context: The original text mapping targeted the old Medication.name element. Later FHIR-8553 removed Medication.name and moved textual description guidance into Medication.code, and later FHIR-45876 reaffirmed that Medication.code.text can carry a medication name. Medication is active in source/fhir.ini, and FHIR-7806 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Updated source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml so the active Medication.code v2 mapping retains the existing .1 code component mappings and adds the corresponding .2 text component mappings, including RXC-2.2 Component Text.
source_changes: source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml: expanded the Medication.code v2 mapping to include RXO/RXE/RXD/RXG/RXA/RXC .2 text components, including RXC-2.2 Component Text.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published tracker for RXC-2.1 Component Code; it is already represented on the combined branch and confirms the code side of the same Medication.code v2 mapping family.
Removed Medication.name and moved textual medication description/name guidance into Medication.code, which determines the current source target for this reconciliation.
Reaffirmed that Medication.code.text can carry a medication name and is already represented on the combined branch.
